title: JML Request Automation & Jira Provisioning System

solution: Led end-to-end delivery of the JML Requests & Admin web application, a Google Apps Script (GAS) + Google Sheets workflow that digitizes Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) requests and automates Jira Cloud issue/subtask creation after admin approval, without blocking approvers. Owned the project from system design and data modeling (Requests/Issues/Audit schemas, status state machine, rules-driven Jira mapping) through implementation planning, security, and deployment, coordinating stakeholders to define approval SLAs, bulk actions, and audit requirements. Implemented an asynchronous Approve → Queue → Background Worker pattern using time-driven triggers and LockService to process queued approvals reliably, with robust error handling (recoverable “Ticket Creation Failed” state), observability via append-only audit logging, and performance optimizations (batched sheet reads, cached Jira issue types, minimal writes). Coordinated deployment/runbook setup across Google Workspace scopes, Admin Directory enablement (for email suggestions/people lookup), Jira permissions, and operational procedures (token rotation, rule updates, reprocessing), enabling scalable, controlled IT ticket automation for employee lifecycle changes.
